items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: he’s got pictures of Malcolm X, Duke Ellington, all in his brain

ctx.x: But you know his collages were so revealing. One of his collages he has a huge picture of himself and in that picture of himself he’s got pictures of Malcolm X, Duke Ellington, all in his brain, all the men that he admired. Did you ever see that collage?
